cmd.arch.wall.desc: Draws a wall point by point on the current level. Click points, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.wall_room.desc: Creates walls along a room outline. Pick a room and walls are placed along its boundary.
cmd.arch.door.desc: Inserts a door into a wall. Hover over a wall and click where to place it.
cmd.arch.window.desc: Inserts a window into a wall. Hover over a wall and click where to place it.
cmd.arch.component.desc: Places a family component such as furniture or equipment. Pick a type, then click a point in the view.
cmd.arch.column.desc: Places an architectural column at a point. Click points to place, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.roof.desc: Creates a roof from an outline. Click the outline points, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.ceiling.desc: Creates a ceiling from an outline. Click the outline points, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.floor.desc: Creates a floor from an outline on the current level. Click the outline points, Enter to finish.
cmd.arch.curtain_wall.desc: Draws a curtain wall between two points on the current level. Click start and end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.stair.desc: Creates a stair between levels. Click the start and the run direction, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.railing.desc: Creates a railing along a path. Click path points, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.ramp.desc: Creates a ramp along a rise line. Click the start and the end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.shaft.desc: Cuts an opening through several levels. Click the outline points, Enter to finish.
cmd.arch.opening.desc: Cuts an opening in a wall. Pick a wall and set the opening bounds.
cmd.arch.room.desc: Creates a room inside a closed boundary of walls. Click inside the boundary, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.room_sep.desc: Draws a line that divides rooms where there is no wall. Click two points in the plan.
cmd.arch.zone.desc: Creates a zone for grouping rooms. Click the outline points, Enter to finish.
cmd.arch.level.desc: Adds a level at a given elevation. Click the height in a section or elevation, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.grid.desc: Draws a grid line between two points. Click the start and the end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.arch.refplane.desc: Draws a reference plane between two points as a construction guide. Click the start and the end.
cmd.str.beam.desc: Draws a beam between two points. Click the start and the end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.str.column.desc: Places a structural column at a point. Click points to place, Esc to cancel.
cmd.str.wall.desc: Draws a structural wall point by point on the current level. Click points, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.
cmd.str.slab.desc: Creates a structural floor from an outline. Click the outline points, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.
cmd.str.footing.desc: Places a footing under a column. Click a column or a point in the plan.
cmd.str.beam_system.desc: Creates a beam system inside a closed boundary. Click the outline points, Enter to finish.
cmd.str.brace.desc: Draws a brace between two points. Click the start and the end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.str.grid.desc: Draws a grid line between two points. Click the start and the end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.str.at_grids.desc: Places elements at grid intersections in one step. Select the grids, then confirm.
cmd.str.strip_footing.desc: Draws a strip footing under a wall. Pick a wall or click two points.
cmd.str.raft.desc: Creates a foundation slab from an outline. Click the outline points, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.
cmd.str.rebar.desc: Adds reinforcement to a selected structural element. Select the element and set parameters.
cmd.str.analytical.desc: Shows or hides the analytical model of structural elements. Run again to toggle back.
cmd.str.level.desc: Adds a level at a given elevation. Click the height in a section or elevation, Esc to cancel.
cmd.str.refplane.desc: Draws a reference plane between two points as a construction guide. Click the start and the end.
cmd.mep.duct.desc: Routes a duct between two points. Click the start and the end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.mep.fitting.desc: Places a fitting or accessory on a run. Pick a type and click a spot on the run.
cmd.mep.equipment.desc: Places MEP equipment. Pick a type, then click a point in the view.
cmd.mep.terminal.desc: Places an air terminal. Pick a type, then click a point in the view.
cmd.mep.pipe.desc: Routes a pipe between two points. Click the start and the end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.mep.fixture.desc: Places a plumbing fixture. Pick a type, then click a point in the view.
cmd.mep.tray.desc: Routes a cable tray between two points. Click the start and the end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.mep.device.desc: Places an electrical device or outlet. Pick a type, then click a point in the view.
cmd.mep.light.desc: Places a light fixture. Pick a type, then click a point in the view.
cmd.mep.conduit.desc: Routes a conduit between two points. Click the start and the end, Esc to cancel.
cmd.mep.connect.desc: Connects the selected element to a run or equipment. Select the element, then the target.
cmd.mep.system.desc: Creates an MEP system from the selected elements. Select the elements and confirm.
cmd.mep.check_system.desc: Checks a system for connectivity gaps. Select an element of the system.
cmd.mep.route.desc: Routes a run automatically between two points. Click the start and the end.
cmd.ann.dim.desc: Places a linear dimension between two points. Click two points, then the dimension line position.
cmd.ann.dim_angular.desc: Places an angular dimension between two lines. Pick the lines, then the arc position.
cmd.ann.dim_radial.desc: Places a radial dimension on an arc or circle. Pick the arc, then the text position.
cmd.ann.spot_elev.desc: Places a spot elevation at a point. Click a point in a plan, section or elevation.
cmd.ann.dim_auto.desc: Automatically places a dimension chain along a wall. Select a wall.
cmd.ann.text.desc: Adds a text note to the view. Click a spot and type the text.
cmd.ann.tag.desc: Tags an element. Hover over an element and click.
cmd.ann.tag_all.desc: Tags every element in the view that has no tag yet.
cmd.ann.leader.desc: Draws a leader with text. Click a point on the element, then the label position.
cmd.ann.detail.desc: Places a detail component in the view. Pick a type and click a point.
cmd.ann.region.desc: Draws a filled region from a closed outline. Click the outline points, Enter to finish.
cmd.ann.detail_line.desc: Draws a detail line visible only in this view. Click two points.
cmd.ann.cloud.desc: Draws a revision cloud around a changed area. Click the area outline points, Enter to finish.
cmd.ann.legend.desc: Creates a legend of symbols that can be placed on sheets.
cmd.mod.paste.desc: Pastes elements from the clipboard. Click the insertion point.
cmd.mod.cut.desc: Cuts the selected elements to the clipboard. Select elements, then run the command.
cmd.mod.copy_clip.desc: Copies the selected elements to the clipboard. Select elements, then run the command.
cmd.mod.match.desc: Copies properties from one element to others. Pick a source, then click the target elements.
cmd.mod.join.desc: Joins overlapping elements or separates them. Select two elements.
cmd.mod.cut_geom.desc: Cuts one element's geometry out of another. Pick the cutting element, then the one to cut.
cmd.mod.align.desc: Aligns elements to a chosen line. Pick the reference line, then the elements to align.
cmd.mod.offset.desc: Creates a parallel copy at a set distance. Select an element, enter the offset, pick the side.
cmd.mod.mirror.desc: Mirrors elements about an existing axis. Select elements, then pick the axis.
cmd.mod.mirror_draw.desc: Mirrors elements about a drawn axis. Select elements, then click two axis points.
cmd.mod.move.desc: Select elements, then click a base point and a destination point.
cmd.mod.copy.desc: Select elements, then click a base point and points for the copies. Esc to finish.
cmd.mod.rotate.desc: Select elements, then click the center and the rotation angle.
cmd.mod.trim.desc: Trims or extends two elements to a common corner. Click the parts of the elements to keep.
cmd.mod.extend.desc: Extends an element to a boundary. Pick the boundary, then the element.
cmd.mod.split.desc: Splits an element into two parts. Select an element and click the split point.
cmd.mod.array.desc: Repeats elements in a row or around a circle. Select elements, then set the count and spacing.
cmd.mod.pin.desc: Pins selected elements against accidental moves or unpins them. Select elements first.
cmd.mod.unpin.desc: Unpins selected elements so they can be moved again. Select elements first.
cmd.mod.delete.desc: Deletes the selected elements from the project. Select elements, then run the command.
cmd.mod.group.desc: Combines the selected elements into a group. Select elements, then run the command.
cmd.mod.hide.desc: Hides the selected elements in the current view. Bring them back with Reveal hidden.
cmd.mod.isolate.desc: Keeps only the selected elements visible and hides the rest. Select elements first.
cmd.mod.reveal.desc: Temporarily shows the elements hidden in the view. Select the ones you need and apply to view.
cmd.mod.measure.desc: Measures the distance between two points. Click the first and the second point.
cmd.view.filters.desc: Controls element visibility and graphics in a view using parameter filters.
cmd.view.template.desc: Applies a view template to the current view. Pick a template from the list.
cmd.view.detail_level.desc: Switches the view detail level. The higher the level, the more element detail is shown.
cmd.view.style.desc: Cycles the display style: wireframe, shaded, realistic.
cmd.view.thin_lines.desc: Turns thin-lines mode on or off: all lines are drawn at minimum weight.
cmd.view.3d.desc: Opens the default 3D view showing the whole model.
cmd.view.section.desc: Creates a section. Click two points of the section line and the viewing side.
cmd.view.plan.desc: Creates a new plan for a chosen level. Pick a level from the list.
cmd.view.schedule.desc: Creates a schedule, a table of elements of a chosen category with their parameters.
cmd.view.elevation.desc: Creates elevation views for each compass side of the building.
cmd.view.tabs.desc: Keeps the view tab strip on top, with the plan and 3D tabs, even when no section is open. Run again to show it only for open views.
cmd.view.tile.desc: Shows the plan beside 3D, or beside the open section or elevation. Run again to return to a single view.
cmd.view.ui.desc: Opens interface settings: layout, ribbon and panel choices.
cmd.view.zoom_fit.desc: Zooms the view so the whole model fits the window.
cmd.view.level_up.desc: Switches the view to the level above the current one.
cmd.view.level_down.desc: Switches the view to the level below the current one.
cmd.view.underlay.desc: Shows the plan of the level below faintly under the current one. Run again to turn it off.
cmd.view.section_box.desc: Limits the 3D view with a section box around the selected elements. Select elements first.
cmd.view.diff.desc: Compares two project versions and shows the differences in 3D. Pick a version to compare.
cmd.view.sheet.desc: Creates a new sheet to which views can then be added.
cmd.view.place.desc: Places a view on a sheet. Pick a view and click a point on the sheet.
cmd.mgr.units.desc: Opens the project units and regional standards.
cmd.mgr.snaps.desc: Opens snap settings: which points are captured while drawing.
cmd.mgr.materials.desc: Opens the project materials for viewing and editing.
cmd.mgr.object_styles.desc: Sets lines, colors and weights for the project element categories.
cmd.mgr.keymap.desc: Opens keys and layouts. Change command shortcuts and mnemonics here.
cmd.mgr.project_info.desc: Opens the project information: name, address, client and other fields.
cmd.mgr.phases.desc: Opens the project phases: create, rename and reorder phases.
cmd.mgr.level.desc: Adds a level at a given elevation. Click the height in a section or elevation, Esc to cancel.
cmd.mgr.grid.desc: Creates a grid line or a whole grid layout. Click two points, Esc to cancel.
cmd.mgr.coords.desc: Opens project coordinates and georeference: origin, rotation and position on the site.
cmd.mgr.library.desc: Opens the family library. Pick a family to load it into the project.
cmd.mgr.load.desc: Loads a family from a file into the project. Pick a family file.
cmd.mgr.types.desc: Opens the types of the selected category: create, edit and delete.
cmd.mgr.params.desc: Opens the family parameters: add, edit and delete.
cmd.mgr.purge.desc: Finds unused types and families and removes them from the project after confirmation.
cmd.mgr.autosave.desc: Configures project autosave: on/off and the interval.
cmd.mgr.warnings.desc: Opens the list of model warnings. Click a warning to locate the element.
cmd.mgr.links.desc: Manages linked models: add, reload and remove links.
cmd.mgr.import_cad.desc: Imports a DWG or DXF drawing into the current view. Pick a file.
cmd.mgr.import_pdf.desc: Places a PDF in the view as an underlay. Pick a file and set its position.
cmd.mgr.workplane.desc: Sets the work plane for drawing. Pick a level, a face or a reference plane.
cmd.mgr.scripts.desc: Scripts: edit files (JSON envelopes) from the scripts folder. Preview what a script would change, then run it as one undo step.
cmd.mgr.record.desc: Records your actions into a script. Start recording, run commands, then stop.
cmd.data.import_xlsx.desc: Reads changes from an XLSX workbook and previews them before applying. Pick a file and confirm.
cmd.data.export_xlsx.desc: Exports element parameters to an XLSX sheet. Pick the destination file.
cmd.data.export_ifc.desc: Saves a copy of the model as an IFC file. Pick the destination file.
cmd.data.export_ifc4.desc: Saves a copy as IFC4, the schema most BIM packages and viewers read. Pick the destination file.
cmd.data.export_ifc4x3.desc: Saves a copy as IFC4.3 (IFC4X3_ADD2). Pick the destination file.
cmd.data.export_ifc2x3.desc: Saves a copy as IFC2x3 for older software. Structural analysis and reinforcement are not written in this schema. Pick the destination file.
cmd.data.export_pdf.desc: Exports sheets to PDF or SVG. Select sheets and the destination folder.
cmd.data.export_gltf.desc: Saves the 3D model as glTF for viewing and sharing. Pick the destination file.
cmd.data.table.desc: Opens a chosen set of elements as a table for viewing and editing parameters.
cmd.data.compare.desc: Compares two project versions and shows the differences in 3D. Pick a version to compare.
cmd.data.check.desc: Checks the model against rules and IDS files. Pick a rule set and run the check.
cmd.data.clash.desc: Finds elements that intersect each other or a linked model. Run the search and review clashes.
cmd.data.query.desc: Finds elements with a query such as walls height>3000. Select the result, or change it with -> field=value as one undo step.
cmd.data.classify.desc: Assigns classification codes to elements. Select elements and a classification.
cmd.ai.ask.desc: Runs a plain-language request with AI. Describe what you want to do or find out.
cmd.ai.explain.desc: AI explains the selected element and its parameters. Select an element, then run the command.
cmd.ctx.wall.profile.desc: Edits the elevation outline of the selected wall. Drag or type its points, or start from a preset, then apply.
cmd.ctx.wall.attach.desc: Attaches the top or base of a wall to a roof, floor or level. Select the wall, then the target.
cmd.ctx.mep.fitting.desc: Inserts a fitting into the selected run: a transition to another size at a distance from its start, or a cap on an end.
cmd.arch.section.desc: Creates a section. Click two points of the section line and the viewing side.
cmd.mod.change_type.desc: Changes the type of the selected elements. Select elements, then pick a type from the list.
cmd.mod.select_similar.desc: Selects elements of the same type as the selected one in the current view. Select a sample first.
cmd.mod.select_filter.desc: Opens the selection filter: keep only the categories you need in the selection.
cmd.mod.ungroup.desc: Breaks a group into individual elements. Select a group, then run the command.
cmd.mod.explain.desc: Explains why an element looks or behaves the way it does. Select an element.
cmd.view.warnings.desc: Opens the list of model warnings. Click a warning to locate the element.
cmd.view.zoom_sel.desc: Zooms the view to the selected elements. Select elements, then run the command.
cmd.view.hide_cat.desc: Temporarily hides the category of the selected element in the view. Select an element.
cmd.view.sync_sel.desc: Selection sync: elements selected in one view are brought into view in the other shown views (the plan follows their level). Run again to turn it off.
cmd.view.maximize.desc: Expands the view to the whole workspace. Run again to restore the previous layout.
cmd.mgr.level_rename.desc: Renames a level or changes its elevation. Select a level and enter the new values.
cmd.mgr.level_delete.desc: Deletes the selected level. Select a level and confirm.
cmd.ai.fix.desc: AI suggests fixes for check results. Review the options and apply the ones you want.
cmd.app.palette.desc: Opens command search. Start typing a name and press Enter.
cmd.app.where_is.desc: Shows where a command lives in the ribbon. Describe what you need in your own words.
cmd.file.open.desc: Opens a project from a file. Pick the file in the dialog.
cmd.file.save.desc: Saves the project to its current file.
cmd.file.save_as.desc: Saves the project to a new file. Choose a name and folder.
cmd.edit.undo.desc: Undoes the last action. Repeat to step back several actions.
cmd.edit.redo.desc: Restores an action that was undone.
cmd.edit.cut.desc: Cuts the selected elements to the clipboard. Select elements, then run the command.
cmd.edit.copy.desc: Copies the selected elements to the clipboard. Select elements, then run the command.
cmd.edit.paste.desc: Pastes elements from the clipboard. Click the insertion point.
cmd.edit.paste_aligned.desc: Pastes copied elements at the same position as the originals.
cmd.edit.select_all.desc: Selects all elements in the current view.
cmd.app.find.desc: Opens the find window on the find field: searches text notes, room names and numbers, marks, comments and text parameters. Ctrl+H adds the replace row; Select all matches selects the found elements.
cmd.view.goto.desc: Jumps to another view: plans, 3D, sections, elevations, drafting views and sheets. Type to filter, Enter opens.
cmd.view.next.desc: Switches to the next view tab.
cmd.view.plan_here.desc: Opens a plan for the current viewpoint.
cmd.view.section_here.desc: Creates a section through the current viewpoint across the whole model and opens it: from the plan centre looking north, along the 3D camera, or across the open section.
cmd.panel.browser.desc: Shows or hides the project browser, a tree of views, sheets and families.
cmd.panel.properties.desc: Shows or hides the properties panel of the selected element.
cmd.panel.issues.desc: Shows or hides the checks panel with the issues found.
cmd.ui.layout.set.1.desc: Switches to the interface layout with the classic ribbon.
cmd.ui.layout.set.2.desc: Switches to the contextual layout: the ribbon shows commands for the selected element.
cmd.ui.layout.set.3.desc: Switches to the layout with a plan and a 3D view side by side.
cmd.ui.layout.set.4.desc: Switches to the Focus layout: fewest panels, most room for the view.
cmd.ui.layout.set.5.desc: Switches to the layout with a 3D model and a table side by side.
cmd.ui.layout.next.desc: Switches to the next interface layout.
cmd.ui.layout.prev.desc: Switches to the previous interface layout.
cmd.ui.layout.settings.desc: Opens interface settings: layout, ribbon and panel choices.
cmd.app.help.desc: Shows help for the selected command.
cmd.app.repeat.desc: Repeats the last command you ran.
cmd.mod.apply_hide.desc: Makes temporary hide or isolate permanent for the view.
cmd.mod.select_similar_project.desc: Selects elements of the same type as the selected one across the project. Select a sample.
cmd.mass.extrude.desc: Creates a mass by extruding a profile. Draw an outline, set the depth and finish.
cmd.mass.revolve.desc: Creates a mass by revolving a profile around an axis. Draw the profile and axis, set the angle.
cmd.mass.sweep.desc: Creates a mass by sweeping a profile along a path. Draw the path, then the profile.
cmd.mass.blend.desc: Creates a mass by blending two profiles. Draw the bottom and the top profile.
cmd.mass.swept_blend.desc: Creates a mass by sweeping along a path with a blend between two profiles. Draw the path and both profiles.
cmd.mass.void.desc: Creates a void that cuts volume out of other masses. Draw a profile and set the depth.
cmd.mass.push_pull.desc: Pushes or pulls a mass face. Pick a face and drag it.
cmd.mass.fillet.desc: Rounds an edge of a mass. Pick an edge and set the radius.
cmd.mass.chamfer.desc: Chamfers an edge of a mass. Pick an edge and set the size.
cmd.mass.shell.desc: Hollows out a mass, leaving walls of a set thickness. Pick a mass and the thickness.
cmd.mass.offset.desc: Offsets the selected mass faces by a set distance. Pick faces and enter the offset.
cmd.mass.split_face.desc: Divides a mass face into parts. Pick a face and draw the dividing line.
cmd.mass.push_region.desc: Draws an outline right on a flat face of a mass and pushes or pulls only that region.
cmd.mass.draft.desc: Tilts faces of a mass by an angle about a neutral plane, keeping the mass closed.
cmd.mass.paint.desc: Paints a mass face with a chosen material. Pick a material, then click faces.
cmd.mass.union.desc: Merges the selected masses into one. Select masses, then run the command.
cmd.mass.subtract.desc: Subtracts the second mass from the first. Pick the first mass, then the one to subtract.
cmd.mass.intersect.desc: Keeps only the common volume of the selected masses. Select masses, then run the command.
cmd.mass.join.desc: Joins the geometry of touching masses. Select two masses.
cmd.mass.unjoin.desc: Breaks the geometry join between masses. Select the joined masses.
cmd.mass.cut.desc: Cuts one element's geometry out of another. Pick the cutting element, then the one to cut.
cmd.mass.wall_by_face.desc: Creates a wall on the selected mass face. Click a face.
cmd.mass.curtain_by_face.desc: Creates a curtain wall on the selected mass face. Click a face.
cmd.mass.slab_by_face.desc: Creates a floor on the selected mass face. Click a face.
cmd.mass.roof_by_face.desc: Creates a roof on the selected mass face. Click a face.
cmd.mass.floors.desc: Creates floors at levels inside a mass. Select a mass and the levels.
cmd.view.sheet_set.desc: Groups sheets into a set for printing and export. Select the sheets.
cmd.view.sheets_for_levels.desc: Creates sheets with plans for several levels at once. Select levels and confirm.
cmd.view.print_sheets.desc: Prints sheets. Select the sheets and a printer.
cmd.arch.dormer.desc: Cuts a dormer opening in a roof. Pick the roof and click the outline.
cmd.arch.roof_opening.desc: Cuts an opening in a roof. Click the outline points, Enter to finish.
cmd.arch.roof_extrusion.desc: Creates a roof by extruding a profile. Draw the profile and set the length.
cmd.arch.ceiling_opening.desc: Cuts an opening in a ceiling. Click the outline points, Enter to finish.
cmd.str.slab_opening.desc: Cuts an opening in a floor. Click the outline points, Enter to finish.
cmd.ctx.wall.detach.desc: Detaches the top of a wall from a roof or floor. Select a wall.
cmd.ctx.floor.sketch.desc: Edits the boundary of the selected floor. Edit the boundary lines, then finish.
cmd.ctx.floor.shape.desc: Edits the points and edges of a floor, for example to create a slope.
cmd.mod.wall_edit.desc: Joins, profile, vertical structure and openings of the selected wall in a separate window. Select a wall.
cmd.mod.curtain_edit.desc: Grid, panels and mullions of the selected curtain wall in a separate window. Select a curtain wall.
cmd.mod.select_same_cat.desc: Selects all elements of the same category as the selected one in the view.
cmd.mod.select_same_cat_project.desc: Selects all elements of the same category as the selected one across the project.
cmd.mod.distribute.desc: Distributes the selected elements evenly along a wall. Select elements and a wall.
cmd.ann.number.desc: Numbers elements in order. Click the elements in the sequence you want.
cmd.data.clash_report.desc: Builds a report of the clashes found. Run the clash search first.
cmd.mod.demolish.desc: Marks the selected elements as demolished in the current phase. Select elements first.
cmd.mgr.project_params.desc: Opens project parameters: add and edit parameters for categories.
